positions.commentary: Netflix has nearly 200 million streaming members and under 2 million DVD subscribers after separating the services.
Amazon is described as an incredible company that has done amazing amounts of innovation, arguably more than Netflix.
Google's approach to innovation is described as top-down and super courageous, unlike the bottom-up approach of Netflix and Amazon.

thesis: The episode argues that Amazon and Netflix are exceptional companies driven by bottom-up innovation, with Netflix having successfully pivoted to become the best streaming service despite a recent pricing error. In contrast, Google's innovation approach is characterized as top-down and courageous, distinguishing it from the other two firms. The discussion also notes Netflix's significant shift in subscriber composition following the separation of its DVD and streaming services.
